I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The last figure posted in that channel is 10%, and I couldn't check it against the contract.

- **Why he remembers 12:** Bettina posted "12% now" on 2025-11-17. Five minutes later she wrote "please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%", saying she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark.
- **How current it is:** That post is almost a year old.
- **Why I stopped there:** Saltmarsh is Sofia's account, not Kwame's. Contract and pricing terms can only go to Sofia, Anselm and June, so I did not look up or share them. I could repeat the 10% because it was already in that channel.
- **What I told him:** Confirm the current number with Sofia or June before the renewal brief goes out.

No approval was needed, so I didn't file a request.
